caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden cabinet with rich brown tones and intricate design details. The top section features two oval-shaped glass panels, each bordered by decorative blue accents in the corners, and is topped by a carved, ornate crest with scrollwork. Below the glass panels, there is a wooden panel with a symmetrical, oval inlay bordered by small bead-like decorations. The lower section consists of a flat surface or countertop, beneath which are two drawers with round handles and a deeper wooden grain pattern. Under the two drawers are two cabinet doors, each decorated with a pointed arch motif and matching wood grain patterns. The cabinet stands on four short curved legs. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a small line drawing with dimensions of the cabinet, providing an outline view of its shape and proportions. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background, bordered by a thin red line. The drawing is signed "ERNEST TOWERS JR." with the designation "DEL. 156-1" in the lower right corner.
title: Secretary
